subject: gh-garage-stain
q: How big is the garage stain, and whose is it?
detail:
TWO READINGS NOW SIT ON ONE STAIN AND THE ARCHIVE IS NOT GOING TO QUIETLY MERGE THEM.

The filed record says: near the back wall of the first bay, hip height against the workbench, WHITE AND INNOCUOUS, visible in daylight if you know where to look, glowing under UV — and Sera and Bella whistle off-key when asked, which attributes it to the two of them.

Viraena's account on 7 September says: A WHITE STAIN THE SIZE OF A MASSIVE PUDDLE, and names it as the direct consequence of the whole family building the compound beam by beam and orgasm by orgasm across Arc 4 — which makes it older than the Vargases' claim to it and very much larger.

Both can be true if the stain is a construction-era accumulation that Sera and Bella later added to and now take credit for, which is exactly the kind of thing those two would do. The Archive finds that reading likely AND IS NOT FILING IT, because 'likely' is how it invented four universe-gifted cocks. One sentence from Viraena settles it.

ANSWERED 7 SEPTEMBER. IT IS ALL BELLA. Sera fucked her in the garage often and frequently during construction, THE CONCRETE WAS STILL WET, and it cured in rather than soaked in — which is why it is load-bearing. Bella says GIGGITY when asked. See c-garage-stain-closed. RETIRED.
